daily.title: After MP 'attacked' in the street, our democracy is facing its biggest test
daily.summary: With four words, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese laid bare the horrifying nature of an attack that has sent shock waves through Australia.

daily.title: What we know about the 'attack' on Helen Haines

daily.title: Israel police arrest suspects over settler attacks
daily.summary: The arrests were made after the United States, France, Belgium and Poland called on Israel to take action after diplomats and a photojournalist were attacked.

daily.title: Tropics attract city dwellers in regional migration trend
daily.summary: New data shows city dwellers are moving to regional Australia at levels matching records set in the pandemic.

daily.title: Funeral held for Corporal Brendan Hannam killed in military exercise
daily.summary: Corporal Brendan Hannam has been remembered as a "man of character" and "a loving partner" at his funeral today. The 28-year-old Australian soldier was killed during a military training exercise in Darwin a fortnight ago.

daily.title: Massive whale carcass leaves council with $180k bill, budget headache
daily.summary: The cost of removing a massive humpback whale that washed up on a popular Perth beach last month cost almost $180,000, with the local council fretting about how to pay for it.

daily.title: NT public housing tenants told 'three strikes' and you're out
daily.summary: Under a new three strikes policy for Northern Territory public housing tenants, "minor" anti-social behaviour breaches attract one strike, "moderate" breaches two and three strikes can be handed down for "significant" breaches.

daily.title: Wind makes conditions tricky for fire crews in Tasmania's north
daily.summary: Firefighters have been kept busy by windy conditions and a "difficult to control" bushfire threatening properties in Tasmania's north.

daily.title: Six-year plastics factory fight takes toll on Moss Vale residents
daily.summary: Residents tell the NSW Land and Environment Court the dispute over the recycling plant is affecting their health, retirement plans and taking psychological toll due to sustained uncertainty.

daily.title: Live: Indi MP Helen Haines critically injured after 'attack' at electorate office
daily.summary: Anthony Albanese says counter-terrorism police are investigating and a man has been arrested after Indi MP Helen Haines was "attacked" near her electorate office in Victoria's north-east. Follow the latest in our live blog.

daily.title: Sydney councillor resigns from Hunter's Hill Council over 'toxic chamber'
daily.summary: Marc Lane said he could not continue serving the rest of his term on the Liberal-dominated council, citing a lack of debate over key council decisions.

daily.title: Australia could be without structural and rail steelmaking for up to five years
daily.summary: Whyalla workers say critical safety equipment like heat suits contained "massive holes" when the plant was run by Sanjeev Gupta, whose company GFG Alliance is not taking responsibility for the broken blast furnace.

daily.title: Police 'unable to rule out' dogs' involvement in man's death after attack
daily.summary: Officers found the body of a 48-year-old man in bushland off Kittyhawk Drive at Chermside just before midday on Sunday.

daily.title: Live: Wet outfield delays start of play on day two
daily.summary: After a false start on day one, Australia and South Africa hope for far more action on day two of the second Test at St George's Park in Gqeberha. Follow live.

daily.title: 'This wasn't an accident': Helen Haines hit by car outside electorate office
daily.summary: Independent MP Helen Haines has been critically injured in what the prime minister says was a deliberate attack, sparking shock and anger across the political spectrum.

daily.title: Navy member stood down with pay after recording device found
daily.summary: The navy's vice admiral said the decision for the person to continue to receive pay was "normal convention" during an investigation.

daily.title: Aussie seamer Darcie Brown cut down by back injury
daily.summary: Darcie Brown's WBBL season is over before it begins, and the seamer's chances of featuring in Australia's T20 Women's Champions Trophy campaign is also in doubt after a back injury.

daily.title: St Kilda AFL player Charlie Banfield accidentally runs over friend with car
daily.summary: St Kilda AFL player Charlie Banfield accidentally ran over his close friend with a car on a private property in WA's south-west earlier this month.

daily.title: Report into department's handling of Kumanjayi Little Baby to be released
daily.summary: Five months after it was first announced, a report into Kumanjayi Little Baby's contact with the child protection system before her alleged murder is set to be tabled in parliament tomorrow.

daily.title: Man who traded fake gold bars for e-bike ordered to repay $7.5k
daily.summary: A New South Wales man is given a two-year good behaviour bond for trading fake gold bullion for an electric mountain bike.

daily.title: Voluntary assisted dying uptake in WA far higher than predicted
daily.summary: Almost 3 per cent of deaths in Western Australia are now due to patients using voluntary assisted dying, and authorities expect growth to continue.

daily.title: Boy accused of detaining husband at knifepoint liable for rape, court told
daily.summary: Prosecutors push to convict a teenager they allege "aided and enabled" the sexual assault of a woman in her Cairns home in 2025.

daily.title: NSW government drafts law to allow Upper Hunter mine to increase output
daily.summary: NSW Premier Chris Minns says the legislation will aim to protect 400 jobs at the Mount Pleasant mine to 2032. Environment leaders say it's an overreach by the government, only weeks after a landmark High Court ruling.

daily.title: 'They don't care about other people's feelings': Racism complaints rise
daily.summary: The ACT Human Rights Commission is dealing with a rise in complaints, with more than 2,000 lodged last financial year.
